note: frame_time_session = t_video_start_s + pts_s (pts from the ORIGINAL 4K Camera/1793693299492.mp4; frame indices identical in the 1080p transcode)

provenance.focal_px: MEASURED: far-field image shift vs trajectory yaw in bends, per-pair median 695 px at 1920 (HFOV ~108 deg); rounded to 700

provenance.yaw_deg: MEASURED: lane vanishing point column 842 px on 38 straight frames -> atan((842-960)/700)
provenance.horizon_row: MEASURED: lane vanishing point row 544 px (straight frames)
provenance.lateral_offset_m: ASSUMED 0 (phone near centreline in front of the mirror)
provenance.longitudinal_m: ESTIMATED 1.75 m ahead of rear axle (A6 e-tron proportions), not measured
